validity.summary: The original (2000-era) construction financing for this pipeline was multi-party -- Republic of Karelia government, Kondopoga municipal government, and OAO Kondopoga (a paper-mill company) together covering the bulk of the ~200M RUB project cost, with Gazprom PJSC agreeing only to cover half of the remaining balance -- which is a more complex funding history than a simple single-owner Gazprom project, though it does not necessarily contradict the sheet's recorded current ownership (Gazprom PJSC, 100%).
validity.researcher_notes: Regionally/municipally co-financed Soviet- and post-Soviet-era regional gasification pipelines in Russia were routinely transferred onto Gazprom's balance sheet once complete, which is consistent with (though not proof of) the sheet's recorded 100% Gazprom PJSC ownership today, 25 years after this 2000 financing arrangement. No document found stating the CURRENT ownership split for this specific spur. Not recommending a change to the recorded Owner value -- flagging the historical complexity for the record and for whoever next reviews Owner/Operator for this row.
validity.recommended_action: No change recommended without a source stating current ownership specifically. Worth a note if a future Owner/Operator-tab audit ever revisits this row.

status_reviews.notes: No segment-specific source confirming CURRENT operating status was found this session, despite extensive search. The only source that explicitly names this exact segment (www.dp.ru/a/2000/11/16/Karelskij_gazoprovod_ozh) is a 2000-era article describing the line as still under active construction (11.8 of 56 km laid) -- it predates any plausible completion date by years and cannot speak to current status. The two other pre-existing citations are unusable for this purpose: spb-tr.gazprom.ru/about/history/ (read via Wayback, live host times out) describes only the parent Volkhov-Petrozavodsk trunk and never mentions Kondopoga; ptzgovorit.ru is confirmed (full read + url_verifier) to be about a wholly different pipeline (Volkhov-Segezha-Kostomuksha). OSM/openinframap.org independently maps a feature labeled 'Волхов — Петрозаводск, Отвод к ГРС Кондопога' (branch to Kondopoga gas-distribution station), which is suggestive that the spur is a mapped, presumably functioning part of the network, but is a banned navigation-surface source and not usable as confirming evidence. e-disclosure.ru (Gazprom's 2024 Annual Report) returned HTTP 403 from this machine and was not pursued further given a corporate-wide filing is very unlikely to name a single 56 km spur. No news of any accident, decommissioning, or mothballing specific to this spur was found in any source read (the one pipeline-accident article found, ptzgovorit.ru, is about a different line entirely). Given no positive confirmation AND no contrary evidence, recommending the sheet keep Status='operating' as the most reasonable default (a completed municipal/regional gasification spur delivering gas to an active industrial town -- Kondopoga's paper mill, OAO Kondopoga, was itself a project co-financier -- is not the kind of asset that gets quietly decommissioned), but flagging this explicitly as UNCLEAR rather than a positively-confirmed status this cycle. A future pass should look for a Republic of Karelia gasification-program status page or a Kondopoga district administration source with a current date.
